children: ETH fell below $2,400, and a whale holding a long position of 45,000 ETH is down $4.1 million. According to Odaily, the whale added 28,300 ETH on August 31 after ETH dropped below $2,500, bringing the position to more than $107 million and making it the second-largest ETH position on Hyperliquid. The position was opened at $2,486.37, with a liquidation price of $2,252.68, leaving $233.69 of room before liquidation.

title: ETH Falls Below $2,400 as Whale’s 45,000-Token Long Position Loses $4.1 Million
